title: Falling Concrete
statement: A road has n sections with heights a_i (n up to 2·10^5). One operation moves section j back to position i<j, lowering it by j−i and raising each section passed by 1. The task is the longest possible flat segment. Since a_i − i is invariant and freely permutable, it reduces to the longest run of consecutive integers among the distinct a_i − i, found by sorting or a hash set.
